objective.child: 学完你能用英语向爸爸妈妈请求养一只宠物，并听懂、回答 可以 / 不可以。
objective.parent: 请求养宠物 + 回应许可（May I…? / Yes, you can. / No, you can't.）

words.memo: 单音节 m-ay：ay 读 /eɪ/，和拼音 mei 的韵母一样
单音节 p-e-t：三个字母各读各的音，直接拼
双音节 rab·bit：bb 相连只读一个 /b/
ee 组合读长音 /iː/（衣——）：see / tree / three 同族
old 组合读 /əʊld/：gold / told 同族（goldfish 里就有 gold）
尊称缩写，读 /ˈmɪsɪz/（音近「米西兹」），别按字母读 M-r-s
合成词：gold（金色）+ fish（鱼）= 金鱼，两块都能单独读
双音节 cle·ver：c 读 /k/，结尾 -er 读轻声 /ə/
sh 组合读 /ʃ/（像「嘘——」）：she / ship 同族
双音节 par·rot：rr 相连只读一个 /r/，和 rabbit 的 bb 一样
ck 组合只读一个 /k/：black / clock 同族

stories.title: Dongdong 买兔子
stories.text: Mrs Chen and Dongdong are walking on the street. — Mum, may I have a pet? — Yes, you can. They go to the pet shop. — May I have a rabbit? — Can you take good care of it? — OK. Yes, I can. — It's lovely. May I hold it? — Sure. — It's your new home, Bunny. — Have some carrots.

stories.title: 鹦鹉学舌
stories.text: Xiaoxiao loves animals. “May I have a pet, Dad?” Xiaoxiao asks. “Yes, you can,” her father says. They go to a pet shop. Xiaoxiao chooses a beautiful parrot. She and her father take the parrot home. They are very happy. The parrot can talk. Xiaoxiao likes him very much. “Hi, I'm Haohao,” says Xiaoxiao's brother. “Hi, I'm Haohao,” says the parrot. “Don't follow me!” says Haohao. “Don't follow me!” says the parrot. “Can you take him back to the pet shop?” Haohao asks Xiaoxiao. He's not happy.
tasks: 复述：Haohao 让谁把鹦鹉送回去？

stories.title: 导盲犬小短剧
stories.text: — Look, Tim! There is a cute dog. — He's a guide dog. He can help blind people. He's clever and helpful. — May I touch him? — No, you can't. He's working now.

stories.title: Ben 和 Mia 的生日
stories.text: Today is Ben and Mia's birthday. They go to a pet shop with their parents. Ben chooses a lovely rabbit. Mia looks around, but she doesn't find her favourite pet. She feels a little sad. On their way home, Mia sees a small cat on the street. It looks cute and friendly. “Dad, Mum, may I take it home?” “Can you take good care of it?” Mum asks. “Yes, I can,” Mia says. They take the cat to the vet. The vet checks the cat and says it is healthy. They go home with the cat happily.

parentCard: May I + 动词原形? —— 请求许可（May I have…?）
回答：Yes, you can. / No, you can't.
May I…?（请求许可） vs Can I…?（请求物品/动作，如 Can I use your…?）
